answer: Anchor each identity to one registered beehive: the keeper files the hive's signed weight log and acoustic hum fingerprint every epoch, and the honey's pollen DNA must show lotus from the hive's declared field. A hollow decoy box has no hum, no weight gain, and no lotus pollen, so speakers and syrup fail the cross-check and burn the bond. A farm wanting a hundred votes must keep a hundred real hives, a hundred queens, and a hundred beekeepers through a whole season, paying feed, mite treatment, and winter losses per hive. An honest keeper files one hum per epoch.
